reasoning: This is an E2E test suite and examples repository for distributed workloads on RHOAI/ODH. It contains Go-based integration test suites (tests/kfto, tests/trainer, tests/fms, tests/odh), training examples (Ray, KFTO, fine-tuning), container image definitions (runtime training images, test images, benchmark images), and MPI/GPU benchmarks. It does not implement an operator (no controllers or CRD management), is not a library (not consumed as a dependency), does not run as a service, and is not purely configuration. It is best described as a QE/test-infrastructure repository with supporting examples and container image builds.
